data.title: A2 · 整理白发
data.description: 回到临时住处，A2 坐在矮凳上拢起长发，准备系好再开始修理装备。背后的窗外是安静的废墟。
data.promptProse: Perched on a rusted steel crate inside an overgrown, abandoned factory ruins, battle android A2 reaches back with both hands to gather her long, untamed silver-white mane into a high ponytail. Shafts of morning sunlight cut through broken corrugated roof beams, illuminating floating rust motes, climbing wild greenery, and her combat-hardened silhouette.
data.animaCaption: She gathers her hair before repairing her gear.
